title: BECK
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Fourteen-year-old Yukio 'Koyuki' Tanaka leads a dull life until he rescues an odd-looking dog named Beck, whose owner is 16-year-old guitar prodigy Ryusuke Minami. Koyuki learns guitar from an eccentric middle-aged teacher and joins Ryusuke's band, also called Beck, which struggles toward success in Japan and the United States. Koyuki also grows close to Ryusuke's half-sister Maho.
life_message: It holds up finding a passion, practicing hard and creating something together with friends.
